title: casting/bible.py — read/append-only casting API with hash verification

implementation_notes.atomicity: write to <file>.tmp then os.replace() — POSIX atomic
implementation_notes.hash_storage: casting.sha256.json sidecar (keeps casting.yaml schema-compatible with extra=forbid)
